constraint.reason: Project source and build are pinned to Scala 2.13.
Project build uses the current SBT line declared in `project/build.properties`.
Browser UI code depends directly on the current DOM API surface.

tool.name: test-runner
tool.value: No dedicated test framework detected yet

module-level.focus: Fast deterministic compilation checks for the shared code and the `vast` module.

wave-level.focus: Verifies that the browser bundle still links after changes to game logic, UI, or serialization.

phase-level.focus: Manual browser smoke validation of startup, rendering, and critical gameplay scenarios from `index.html`.

Testing.mocking-policy: Prefer deterministic fixtures, replay logs, and host/browser scenario checks over broad mocks. Introduce fakes only around external boundaries.

Observability.logger: Custom `hrf.logger` bridge to browser console log/warn/error with pprint-based formatting.
Observability.redaction: Do not emit secrets or raw credentials from URL params or online game fields; avoid leaking hidden-information payloads when adding new logs.

DeliveryShape.shape: Static browser app compiled with Scala.js, served from local or remote HTTP, with assets and `index.html` loaded directly by the browser.
